title: It’s Easy to Start a Private School. Take Our Quiz to Find Out Where You Can Open Yours.
author: Millie von Platen
content:
Ever imagine yourself as a private school operator? It’s not such a wild idea.
Hundreds of new private schools have popped up all over the country in recent
years, responding to a surge of public money for students to pay tuition.

A team of ProPublica journalists has spent this year documenting how the
American education landscape is shifting with an [increased push for school
privatization](https://www.propublica.org/series/private-schools-public-
money).

Our reporting has identified big differences in how states regulate who can
run a school, what they must teach and where they can hold class. While some
require new private school operators to prove they’re on the up-and-up, others
invite anyone with a dream and a heartbeat to get into the business.
[ProPublica even founded a couple this
year.](https://www.propublica.org/article/propublica-private-schools-arkansas-
west-virginia-north-carolina)

So why not you? [Take our quiz on ProPublica’s
website](https://projects.propublica.org/private-school-requirements-quiz/) to
find out which states might welcome you to open one with ease, no experience
required.

The post [It’s Easy to Start a Private School. Take Our Quiz to Find Out Where
You Can Open Yours.](https://projects.propublica.org/private-school-
requirements-quiz/) appeared first on
[ProPublica](https://www.propublica.org).
